Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Hiring of Temporary Vehicle for 06 months for compe nsation works of Maharanibagh Narela Line at Mandol a Substation Mahindra Bolero/ Mahindra Scor 1) The scope of the Package is Hiring of Vehicles ( pio/Mahindra TUV 300 DIESEL ) on monthly basis with Drivers and fuel ( ) for local and outstation travel of employees. 2) The vehicles deployed should be 2024/2025 or Ex-showroom brand New vehicle. 3) Vehicles offered should be registered under commercial category in the state of registered in the state of deployment in accordance with Motor Vehicle act and vehicle should have valid commercial permit. 4) The vehicle shall be registered in the name of the person/Agency on whom order shall be placed or the Se rvice Provider may act as an aggregator of vehicles/ individual drivers, who shall be responsible & liable to deliver the services as per the contract and registered in the state of deployment in accordance with Motor Vehicle act and vehicle should have valid commercial permit. All matters concerning the Regional Transpo rt Authority, Insurance and Police authorities etc. shall be the contactors risk and responsibility. Detailed Evaluation Criteria is as following: Bids for hiring of vehicles are being invited based on A + B + C model, where ‘A’ is monthly wage of the Driver as per Minimum Wages criteria of Central Govt/ State Govt(whichever is h

igher) as per notified minimum wages circular on Dt 01.04.2026 plus statutory expenses to be incurred on EPF, EDLI, Admin. Charges, ESI and bonus etc. ‘B’ is fixed monthly Vehicle rental Charges and ‘C’ is monthly Fuel Consumption Charges with tentative running of 3000 KM /Month and Fuel consumption mileage as 12 KMs per litre BOQ/Price Breakup Attached in GeM Bid. Bidders are requested to quote total monthly charges for vehicle hiring considering driver charges in skille d category (as per component A above), cost towards fixed monthly vehicle rental (Component B) and cost towards fuel charges (as per component C above). 3,31,981.65/- A minimum floor price of Rs. considering pre-specified cost of components A a nd C as above has been kept. The differential between Bidder’s quoted price and the minimum floor price shall be towards component B i.e. fixed monthly vehicle rental charges. Bidders shall not upload the price details in the technical part other wise technical bid will be rejected.
